h13.

**Interface:** `markdown.Service` — defined in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:31-55` (methods: `ExtractAll`, `ExtractTags`, `ExtractProperties`, `RenderMarkdown`, `RenderHTML`, `GenerateSnippet`, `ValidateContent`, `RenameTag`).

**Concrete implementation that executes at runtime:** the unexported `*service` struct in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:58-113`, which wraps a `goldmark.Markdown` instance (goldmark parser + `extension.GFM` + custom `extensions.TagExtension`/`extensions.MentionExtension`) and delegates AST-to-markdown rendering to `renderer.MarkdownRenderer` (`internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go:15-24`). There is only this one production implementation; no mock/alternate `Service` implementation exists in the repo (test code reuses the same real implementation).

**Construction:** built exclusively via `markdown.NewService(markdown.WithTagExtension(), markdown.WithMentionExtension())`, called in two places:
- `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:47-51` inside `NewAPIV1Service`, which is the runtime/production construction path (invoked from `server/server.go:76`).
- `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44-47`, for test setup.

`internal/markdown/renderer.NewMarkdownRenderer()` is constructed ad hoc inside `service.RenderMarkdown` and `service.RenameTag` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:250` and `:451`) each time those methods run — it's an internal detail, not exposed through `markdown.Service`.

**Holders of the `markdown.Service` interface field:**
- `apiv1.APIV1Service.MarkdownService` — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35` (the owner; created here and handed out to the others below).
- `rss.RSSService.MarkdownService` — `server/router/rss/rss.go:45`, populated in `server/server.go:85` with `apiV1Service.MarkdownService` (same instance, shared, not separately constructed).
- `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:14-16` (field exists with a `NewRunner` constructor, but `NewRunner`/`Runner` is currently unused/dead code in the runtime wiring; the package's `RebuildMemoPayload` function instead takes `markdownService markdown.Service` as a plain parameter and is called directly with `s.MarkdownService` from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` and `:447`).

So at runtime there is a single shared `*service` instance (from `internal/markdown`), constructed once in `NewAPIV1Service`, and passed by reference into the RSS router and into memo-service payload rebuilding — all holding it only through the `markdown.Service` interface type.
